We were referred to Dr. Cocca by our veterinarian for a specialist examination for our dog.
We found her to be knowledgeable, empathetic, and precise—essential qualities in any profession, especially medical.
I called this morning for an emergency and they didn't answer. I can't express what you are.
Excellent professionalism

I imagine the doctors are excellent, judging by the reviews, and also very kind, given the people I've had the pleasure of meeting. But we weren't able to personally verify the staff's professionalism because we were, as they say in Naples, literally "swamped." We made an ultrasound appointment at 11:30 a.m. with the secretary, scheduled for 1:30 p.m. We rushed to be on time (my husband had a late night, too). We were coming from Vomero to Bagnoli, in 35°C weather, and the dog hadn't eaten. The secretary scheduled an appointment with us but didn't notify the sonographer. We even called while we were still on Via Terracina to let them know we'd be five minutes late due to traffic, but they didn't let me know. Besides, I had left my phone number! When we got there, they told us, without too much fuss and very casually, that the sonographer had already left. I'm speechless.

We made an appointment for the same day. We called 5 minutes early to let them know we were arriving 5 minutes late. We ran 15 km. The dog was fasting and stressed. Under the 1:30 PM sun. We arrived: the sonographer had left. The secretary hadn't notified her!
Unacceptable. Total lack of professionalism.
Excellent clinic, efficient and very kind, especially the doctor is worth it😊 …
They spoke well of me
With a love for our little furry friends and the utmost professionalism, this is the best place to take your pets, even for a simple check-up.
Welcoming atmosphere and qualified staff. Our Aisha was examined without too much stress. Thank you.
Excellent animal care treated with experience

My vacation started off badly.
On Thursday, June 4th, my Ginger decided to steal and eat a delicious onion omelette.
Knowing how dangerous onions are for dogs, as soon as I realized it, I immediately called for an appointment.
An hour later, I was at the clinic, where I've been going regularly for over two weeks.
We even had a blood transfusion... the situation remained critical for several days... but thanks to the great professionalism and love that the entire staff has and continues to show towards, and not just towards, the four-legged friend, I can only highly recommend the Napolivet veterinary clinic!
Thank you so much for the love with which you've welcomed and supported us over these two weeks. I'm writing this with tears in my eyes...
Thank you 😍😍😍😍
Serena and Ginger
P.S.
Many pet parents don't know about the dangers of onions/garlic/chocolate/raisins/tomatoes...learn more.
I've had some terrible days 😢😰
Exceptional people and professionals
Expert and very professional, my cat felt safe in their hands 🙂 …
THANK YOU :)
Thank you :)

The experience at the veterinary cardiology service was overall negative. The clinical-care approach adopted was not fully satisfactory, either in terms of interpersonal relationships or practical patient management, particularly in the case of a patient with pre-existing heart disease. During a blood pressure measurement procedure, patient handling appeared suboptimal in terms of stress management and behavioral management, in a clinical context already predisposing to respiratory fragility. In this context, a subsequent clinical deterioration was observed, with the onset of dyspnea and the detection of pleural effusion, without it being possible to definitively establish a direct causal link with the procedure. However, as Hippocrates said: "Primum non nocere"—first, do no harm. A principle that, in this clinic, I perceived as not fully respected in the care and management of my animal. Overall, the experience led to a significant reduction in confidence in the perceived quality of the service provided, resulting in a negative overall judgment of the care received.
Friendly and highly trained staff. I had my cat spayed here because they use a minimally invasive procedure, and she recovered quickly without any side effects.

I'm writing here after almost eight years, because for me, NapoliVet represents a place of certainty and sacred trust built over time.

Dr. Miano supports the health of my two puppies, Kyra and Kenya, with a dedication that goes far beyond the medical profession. Her rigorous training—clear, solid, and never ostentatious—is accompanied by a rare quality: the ability to convey genuine security. And those who deeply love their animal know how crucial this is.
When affection makes us vulnerable, being guided by such a competent and naturally empathetic professional lightens the heart. The doctor doesn't just treat: she reassures, explains, and accompanies. And she does so with a restraint and presence that speak of a vocation even more than a profession.
Here I found this: knowledge, dedication, and a confidence that lifts the weight of anxiety.

A heartfelt thanks also goes to Francesco, an assistant who is always available, courteous, and genuinely friendly, as well as an integral part of the atmosphere of trust that distinguishes them.
Her kindness and discreet yet luminous presence help create a welcoming environment, restoring serenity even in the most delicate moments.

Over the years, I've learned that here we don't just care for animals, we protect a bond.
My gratitude isn't episodic, but has been built up over time—and it's immense.

I discovered this clinic on the recommendation of a friend of mine who, like me, has a cat at home. Since I started going there to take my black furry puppy Ninnillo, I haven't changed vets: professionalism, kindness, empathy, care and honesty in prices. Thanks to all the staff at the Napolivet clinic! 🙏❤️ …

There are several doctors (each with their own specialty) who are very competent and kind, and who pay particular attention to our furry "children." My experience has always been positive, and special thanks go to Dr. Diana, who has been treating my cat Cleopatra with care, expertise, and compassion for about eight years.
Highly qualified, friendly, and welcoming staff. Top!
Good morning, I had a good time and thank you.
Dr. Miano is exceptional
Excellent professionalism and kind people
I've been bringing my dogs here for over 15 years. They're all good, reassuring, and never pushy.
Dr. Cocca paved the way for my vocation. If in this life I've learned how a veterinarian should act humanely and ethically, I owe it entirely to her. Top.

Friendliness and empathy are the watchwords, seasoned with a little love... Unfortunately, I have never come here for happy things, but the professionalism in this clinic allows us furry parents to know that the best possible will be done for our "little ones".
Excellent ❤️
The Napolivet clinic employs excellent veterinarians who stand out for their expertise and ability to welcome animals with kindness and professionalism.
Here I was able to have an ultrasound on my cat to find out she was pregnant 🐈! They treated her with such tenderness ❣️ …
Good doctors. The facility is in terrible condition, with very poor hygiene.
Good morning, I'm sorry, I need some help. I've been trying to call for several hours, but it's always busy or no one answers. Is there a specific time to call? Thank you very much.
Dr. Sgambato is a great professional, my dog ​​lives thanks to him!
The absolute best, expertise and professionalism.
We went there to treat our cat and we always had a great experience, we are now customers 😄. Recommended …

The Napolivet Veterinary Clinic is a true reference point for the care of our four-legged friends. Dr. Imma Miano is an exceptional, competent, and passionate professional who demonstrated great care and compassion for my poodle Balu and his friend Nina, who is also a poodle.
Balu was treated with a dedication and professionalism that truly impressed me. Dr. Miano was able to identify the problem and resolve it competently and promptly, demonstrating a profound knowledge of veterinary medicine.
The clinic is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment and the environment is clean and welcoming. All the staff are kind and helpful, creating a reassuring atmosphere for both animals and their owners.
I highly recommend the Napolivet Veterinary Clinic to anyone seeking high-quality veterinary care, where their pets are treated with care and respect. A special thanks to Dr. Imma Miano for her professionalism and compassion.

A small, welcoming, and functional facility.
The atmosphere is relaxed and cheerful, and all the doctors and staff are affectionate with animals and humans alike.
I met Dr. Cocca on the recommendation of my previous vet because my dog ​​Anita needed an oncologist. She allowed us to live with our beloved dog for many more years, caring for her with love, dedication, and attention until her last day. Throughout the years she cared for Anita, she never refused an explanation, clarification, or advice.
Their helpfulness and compassion made us choose their practice to care for our new addition to our family, and we feel completely confident in our decision.
Thank you for everything you do!
The doctors are all very good. I highly recommend them. The waiting room is a bit small.

For years, my dogs, one after the other, have been cared for by Dr. Imma Miano, who, in addition to being highly competent and professional, is a very sweet person. Napoli Vet is a great team, with top-notch specialists. Thank you for all you do for the well-being of our four-legged friends ❤️
Lovely and knowledgeable doctors

The entire staff is extremely professional and helpful, and above all, they are respectful of their patients. I have two cats (one 13 years old and the other 8 months old) under Dr. Romano's care. I had a great impression from the first moment, despite being skeptical due to past negative experiences with doctors at other clinics.
Professionalism, hospitality, courtesy, humanity. I recommend it.

Excellence, professionalism, and dedication.
A perfect team, special thanks to Dr. Burali, a kind, empathetic, and obviously super professional person ❤️

Thanks to Dr. Sgambato

Gabriele
Excellent welcome and professionalism.
Truly exceptional. They take excellent care of our animal friends. Highly recommended.
Thank you !
The doctors are well-prepared and everyone is very kind.

Unparalleled professionalism in a welcoming environment. The empathy of all the staff, both medical and otherwise, is immediately evident.
Well done, and thank you for all you do for our furry friends.
Good doctors, but maximum disorganization.
<3 thanks

My experience with Napolivet wasn't good. It took a very long time (over 10 days) for an oncology consultation despite the seriousness of the patient, and the doctor's incorrect assessment (he's not operable). To my disappointment, however, they very honestly advised me to go to another center (CVRS in Rome), and this saved my cat. He underwent emergency surgery and received the right chemotherapy, and stayed with us for another 15 months. ❤️
